note: sortie de SoftBank le 19 mai 2026 : ses 89 106 748 actions A sont cédées à Tether et ses 89 106 748 actions B annulées ; l'accord de gouvernance prend fin ; aucun flux vers la société
quote: On May 19, 2026, pursuant to a sale and purchase agreement dated May 15, 2026 between Tether and Softbank, whereby Softbank sold and transferred to Tether its holdings of 89,106,748 shares of Class A common stock and 89,106,748 Class B Common Stock held by Softbank were canceled.
